description: This file contains utility functions and classes for license validation, including signature verification, license file handling, and license data extraction for the Mattermost server.

classes.name: LicenseValidatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of license validation logic, including signature verification and license parsing.

methods.name: LicenseFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a License object from license bytes after validating and unmarshalling.

methods.name: ValidateLicense
methods.description: Validates the signed license bytes by decoding, signature verification, and environment-specific public key check.

methods.name: GetAndValidateLicenseFileFromDisk
methods.description: Loads and validates a license file from disk, returning the license object and raw bytes.

methods.name: GetLicenseFileFromDisk
methods.description: Reads license bytes from a specified file.

methods.name: GetLicenseFileLocation
methods.description: Determines the license file location, defaulting to a config directory if not specified.

methods.name: GetClientLicense
methods.description: Extracts license information into a map of string properties for client use.

methods.name: GetSanitizedClientLicense
methods.description: Returns a sanitized copy of license properties, removing sensitive identifiers.
